'''Mase''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who led the [[Wolf Squadron]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] unit during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Mase led his squadron from the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Annamar]], hidden deep within a massive asteroid field near the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]].<ref name="TWODV" />

He led several attacks on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] shipping, including the [[Ambush on the Corellian Trade Spine|attack]] on a convoy that carried a piece of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II's]] weapons systems.<ref name="TWODV" />

As [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] decimated the Rebel base on Annamar, and dropped a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] on the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] stationed in the base, Mase and all the other Rebels were hit by the shockwave.<ref name="TWODV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mase was created by [[Tom Taylor]] for the story [[Star Wars Adventures: The Will of Darth Vader|''The Will of Darth Vader'']], which was the fourth volume of the [[Star Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars Adventures'']] series of [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperbacks]]. In the story, Mase was drawn by [[Brian Koschak]].

==Appearances==
